value.rationale: This exact benchmark for a standard incidence graph measures the full feasible space and its inclusion-minimal frontier. In particular 3224 nine-vertex minimal sets do not contain any of the known 1755 optima, and no inclusion-minimal sets are larger. The result supplies data unavailable from optimum reconfiguration alone.
residual_risks: The result is not a general secure-domination algorithm or an infinite-family theorem.
